name: Outcast Upright
blurb: Walk up to an overturned car, truck or trailer, open the radial menu and flip it back onto its wheels.

name: Outcast Proximity
blurb: Every container you can already reach, as one searchable list.

name: Outcast Husbandry
blurb: Livestock in a designated animal zone get hungry and thirsty far more slowly, so a few days away does not come back to a dead herd.

name: Outcast Saw All
blurb: One context-menu button that saws every log you can get to, in your bags and on the ground around you.

name: Outcast Rip All
blurb: One context-menu button that rips every rippable garment in your inventory and the containers around you.

name: Outcast Light Load
blurb: Hauling raw materials stops being the whole afternoon.

name: Outcast Ladders
blurb: See the ladders hidden behind buildings.

name: Outcast Punch
blurb: Punch zombies with your bare hands. The vanilla shove is untouched.

name: Outcast Motors
blurb: Engines built from twenty-four parts, each with its own condition, that you can pull out, put back and craft.

name: Outcast Motors Animated
blurb: Panels that actually open.

name: Outcast Motors UI
blurb: A vehicle mechanics window that presents the whole car.

name: Outcast Disinfect All
blurb: One option on an oven or sink washes your dirty bandages and sheets and sterilizes the clean ones.

name: Outcast Packing
blurb: Pack 5 to 1000 identical items into one lighter pack, or unpack them again, with every change made by the server.

name: Outcast Search
blurb: A search box on every container you open: your bags, crates, corpses, the floor.

name: Outcast Locking
blurb: Real locks for doors, windows, gates, garage doors and containers.

name: Outcast High Drive
blurb: Drive a car up a ramp and park it on an upper deck in multiplayer.

name: Outcast Musicians
blurb: Playable instruments with a songbook: learn each song from sheet music, master it, and train a Music skill.

name: Outcast Territories
blurb: Zones for the Dystopian Outcasts server: difficulty by area and PvPvE.

name: Outcast Viewpoint
blurb: The Viewpoint first-person mod as our servers run it, with its cheat features taken out.

name: Outcast Achievements
blurb: Achievements for your character, tracked by the server: zombie kills, time survived and total skill levels.

name: Outcast Nature
blurb: Trees, bushes and plants that grow, spread and die over the years on every server.

name: Outcast Buddy
blurb: The helper that lets the game load the Java parts of Outcast mods (the Outcast Viewpoint first-person view and the Outcast loading screen).

name: Dystopian QoL
blurb: Adds weapon and health HUD indicators, a player stat panel, crowbar prying and vehicle dismantling.

name: Dystopian Nexus
blurb: Adds an icon that opens an in-game help window and a death log panel.

name: Dystopian Arsenal
blurb: Adds 14 weapons, 22 bags and a range of clothing, from hats and masks to armor sets.

name: Dystopian Music
blurb: Adds more than 300 cassette tapes and 12 vinyl records to play in the game.

name: Dystopian Vehicle Claim
blurb: Claim a vehicle from the radial menu and keep track of every vehicle you own from a panel.

name: Dystopian Vehicle Respawn
blurb: Removes vehicles left unseen for too long and replaces them nearby, on the server.

name: Dystopian Autos
blurb: A car mod to add custom cars for use on the Dystopian Outcasts Server.

name: Dystopian BioFuel
blurb: A mod that allows a player to create fuel and propane from crops.

name: Dystopian Crossbow
blurb: Adds a Crossbow skill.

name: Dystopian Gym
blurb: A mod that allows players to use Treadmills and Benchpresses.

name: Dystopian Traits
blurb: Adds 58 character traits to the server, including Survivor, Medic, Butcher and Mortician.

name: Dystopian Vehicle Builder
blurb: Lets experienced mechanics build and spawn stripped vehicles from an Automotive Building Kit.

name: Dystopian Spear Fishing
blurb: Restores spear fishing, removed from vanilla in Build 42.

name: Dystopian Tinkering
blurb: Adds a Tinkering skill for re-working melee weapons with randomized tiered affixes.

name: Dystopian Transit
blurb: Lets an admin place bus stops that players use to teleport between stops.

name: Dystopian Build Menu
blurb: A mod that adds an additional Build Menu UI to allow players to customize their base using existing tile sets.

name: Dystopian Basements
blurb: Dig stairwells and excavate basements under your base.

name: Dystopian Vehicle Interiors
blurb: Step inside the back of a stepvan: a small room to rest, sleep and store gear, wherever the van goes.

name: Dystopian Archery
blurb: Bows with custom archery animations.

name: Cosmic Solar
blurb: Silent solar power.

name: Cosmic Loadout
blurb: A black-and-gold overhaul of the equipment and character UI.

name: MRAP Mine Clearer
blurb: Adds an MRAP mine clearer vehicle.

name: Cosmic Realistic Towing
blurb: Towing you can feel.

name: Cosmic Forklift
blurb: Makes the ForkLift mod forklift drivable and adds cargo pallets: drag items in, lift, stack and load them onto trucks and trailers.

name: Cosmic Novelty Cars
blurb: Adds two drivable vehicles: the Shadow Batmobile and the foot-powered BamBamobile.

name: Cosmic Gun Rework
blurb: A Tarkov-inspired firearms overhaul.

name: Cosmic Cinema
blurb: Play your own movies and TV shows on any wall.

name: Cosmic Escalade
blurb: 2003 Cadillac Escalade ESV. Opening doors, hood and rear hatch, working lights, breakable glass, white and green paint.

name: Cosmic Excavator
blurb: A tracked excavator you can drive: the cab swings all the way round, and one button digs a hole and bags the dirt.

name: Flatbed Tow Truck
blurb: A drivable rollback flatbed tow truck (Base.FlatbedTow).

name: Cosmic Humvee
blurb: M998 Humvee with four seats, opening doors, hood and cargo lid, an interior and engine bay, glass that breaks, and working lights.

name: M978 HEMTT Tankers
blurb: M978 HEMTT 8x8 tankers: a 2,500 L fuel tanker and a 2,500 L water tanker.

name: Cosmic Reefer Truck
blurb: A refrigerated box truck with a fridge and a freezer behind a roll-up rear door.

name: Cosmic Road Roller
blurb: A drivable tandem-drum road roller (Base.RoadRoller).

name: Cosmic Skyline R34
blurb: A right-hand-drive Skyline R34 with opening doors, hood and trunk, an interior, breakable glass and an armor kit.

name: Woodgrain Station Wagon (Cosmic)
blurb: A pearl white 1970s woodgrain station wagon.

name: Tymco 600 Street Sweeper
blurb: A drivable street sweeper. Turn it on from the vehicle radial menu and it sweeps items, bodies, blood and litter into its hopper.

name: Tank Trailers (Cosmic)
blurb: Single-axle water and fuel bowser trailers, 1000 L each.

name: Cosmic Water Truck
blurb: A two-seat water truck with opening doors, a tilt-forward front end, working lights and a split tank: 2,500 L of water and 1,500 L of fuel.

name: Cosmic Tornado
blurb: Dynamic weather and dangerous tornadoes.

name: Oshkosh Fleet
blurb: Every Oshkosh vehicle in one mod: the M1070 HET with its semitrailer, the Heavy Wrecker, a flatbed and a dump truck.

name: Squirrelly Industries
blurb: Industrial machines and factory automation for vehicle part manufacturing.
